title: Open Small Business Records Taxonomy
classification_principle: Assign one primary category by the business responsibility that needs the information to stay correct; keep secondary contexts as relationships or metadata.
accountability_test: If this record became wrong or disappeared tomorrow, which business responsibility would have to fix the problem?
small_business_note: Categories describe responsibilities, not departments. One person can own several responsibilities.
tie_breakers: Responsibility beats file format, document type, and department name.
Financial transaction evidence stays in Finance when finance is its primary purpose.
Customer relationships stay with Customers; specific execution stays with Projects.
Procurement stays with Vendors; resulting purchase invoices normally stay with Finance.
Employment relationships stay with People; payroll accounting and remittances normally stay with Finance.
Physical asset records stay with Assets; stock movement and control stay with Inventory.
Claims and incidents stay with Risk; formal licence and compliance evidence stay with Compliance.
System ownership, access, configuration, recovery, and technology services stay with Technology.
Recurring methods stay with Operations; future direction with Strategy; reusable handoff knowledge with Knowledge.
Never displace a required legal, regulatory, accounting, payroll, or contractual system of record.

recommended_metadata.purpose: Stable OSBRT category for primary operational meaning.
Human record type; not the primary category.
Responsibility that owns correctness; one person may fill several.
Local handling cue; not a legal classification.
When or why review, renewal, supersession, or closure is needed.
Other OSBRT categories materially related to the record.
Related customer, vendor, worker, project, asset, account, or location.
Pointer to the authoritative system/original; never store secrets here.

categories.name: Governance & ownership
categories.definition: Records that establish the business entity, ownership, formal authority, governance structure, or major company decisions.
categories.use_when: Entity, ownership, formal authority, or governance action is the primary responsibility.

categories.name: Finance, accounting & tax
categories.definition: Accounting books, transaction evidence, banking, receivables and payables, expenses, reconciliations, financial reporting, tax, and financial-remittance records.
categories.responsibility: Bookkeeping, cash, financial reporting, tax, and transaction evidence.
categories.use_when: The record primarily evidences, records, reconciles, reports, pays, collects, or supports a financial/tax obligation.

categories.name: Customers & revenue
categories.definition: Records that define, develop, manage, or document customer relationships, commercial opportunities, sales commitments, and ongoing customer accounts.
categories.responsibility: Sales and the ongoing customer relationship.
categories.use_when: The commercial customer relationship is primary; specific execution belongs with Projects.

categories.name: Vendors & procurement
categories.definition: Records used to source, evaluate, select, order from, manage, and communicate with suppliers and service providers.
categories.use_when: Choosing, ordering from, or managing a supplier is primary; transaction evidence normally belongs with Finance.

categories.name: People & workforce
categories.definition: Employment, contractor, role, compensation-administration, time, training, performance, and other workforce records about people working for or with the business.
categories.use_when: The working relationship or workforce administration is primary; payroll accounting/remittance evidence normally belongs with Finance.

categories.name: Projects, jobs & delivery
categories.definition: Records that define, execute, change, approve, evidence, complete, or hand off specific customer work, projects, jobs, engagements, or deliverables.
categories.responsibility: Delivery of the specific job, project, or engagement.
categories.use_when: Execution or delivery of a defined job, project, engagement, or deliverable is primary.

categories.name: Operations & procedures
categories.definition: Recurring operating procedures, checklists, schedules, instructions, quality methods, and routine process records used to run the business consistently.
categories.responsibility: The recurring process or operating method.
categories.use_when: A repeatable operating method is primary; topic-specific notes/checklists stay with their actual subject.

categories.name: Assets & facilities
categories.definition: Records that identify, assign, operate, service, inspect, repair, warrant, or manage physical assets, equipment, vehicles, tools, premises, and facilities.
categories.responsibility: The asset, equipment, vehicle, premises, or facility.
categories.use_when: Asset identity, custody, condition, operation, maintenance, warranty, inspection, or facilities management is primary.

categories.name: Inventory & supplies
categories.definition: Records used to identify, count, receive, store, issue, consume, reorder, adjust, or trace inventory, stock, materials, and recurring supplies.
categories.responsibility: Stock availability, movement, and material control.
categories.use_when: Stock or supply control is primary; supplier selection stays with Vendors and invoices stay with Finance.

categories.name: Insurance, risk & incidents
categories.definition: Insurance policies and certificates, claims, risk assessments, incident records, damage evidence, loss events, and other records primarily used to understand or manage business risk.
categories.responsibility: Insurance, claims, risk response, loss prevention, and incident handling.
categories.use_when: Insurance, claims, risk, or incident handling is primary unless formal compliance evidence is the main purpose.

categories.name: Compliance, licences & safety
categories.definition: Licences, permits, required certifications, regulated inspections, safety-program evidence, compliance records, and other material maintained primarily to demonstrate required permission or adherence.
categories.responsibility: The licence, safety duty, regulatory requirement, or compliance evidence.
categories.use_when: A legal, regulatory, licensing, safety, or professional requirement is the record’s main purpose.

categories.name: Technology, access & data
categories.definition: Records that define, operate, administer, secure, recover, or document business systems, software, accounts, access, data handling, and technology services.
categories.responsibility: The system, account, access model, configuration, data process, backup, or technology service.
categories.use_when: The system, account, access model, configuration, data process, backup, or technology service is primary.

categories.name: Marketing & brand
categories.definition: Brand standards, creative assets, campaigns, content, advertising, media, messaging, publication, and other records used to present and promote the business.
categories.responsibility: The brand, campaign, content, public message, or marketing channel.
categories.use_when: Brand or marketing work is primary; customer commercial records and financial invoices stay with their natural responsibilities.

categories.name: Strategy & planning
categories.definition: Business plans, forecasts, priorities, market or internal research, roadmaps, strategic decisions, and records whose main purpose is choosing or directing future action.
categories.responsibility: Future direction, priorities, and major initiatives.
categories.use_when: Forward-looking direction or planning is primary; books, delivery plans, and recurring procedures stay in operating categories.

categories.name: Knowledge & continuity
categories.definition: Operational lessons, durable decision context, reference material, handoff notes, and other records whose main purpose is preserving what the business knows so work can continue across people and time.
categories.responsibility: Reusable know-how, decision context, and continuity across people or time.
categories.use_when: Preserving reusable know-how or continuity is primary; do not use this as miscellaneous storage.
